title: AgentStreamFrame
description: One decoded SSE frame from agent's POST /ask. Describes what a conforming producer emits; chat is deliberately more lenient than this, ignoring unknown frame types and defaulting an absent `answer`, so that agent can add a frame kind without a lockstep release. Validate frames one at a time -- ordering (tokens, then exactly one terminal frame) is asserted by the fixture's consumers, not expressible here.
$comment: Extra keys are allowed throughout: agent emits several fields no consumer reads, and adding another must not break chat.

answer.$comment: Optional, and absent rather than null when an older agent cannot send it. Authoritative when present: the concatenated tokens still contain text the loop stripped.

citation.$comment: A `Citation.__dict__` dump: the dataclass attribute names are the wire names, with no serializer in between to catch a rename.

section_path.$comment: Null, not absent: the dump always carries every field. Chat defaults it anyway, being more lenient than this schema on purpose.

usage.$comment: A `Usage.__dict__` dump. Read by nobody today -- pinned so it cannot drift unnoticed if something starts reading it.

toolCall.$comment: The trace entry the loop appends per call; `error` rides along only on a failure.
